## Projects

- [Dataset Assembly Studio](https://mharsh.me/projects/dataset-assembly-studio): Pipeline for downloading raw LeRobot datasets from Hugging Face, curating and balancing them locally, and exporting verified LeRobot v2.1 datasets.
- [Punch.io](https://mharsh.me/projects/punchio): Turns a team's Discord conversations into a searchable project record with local FAISS semantic search and Groq-powered RAG.
- [Gesture Recognition](https://mharsh.me/projects/gesture-recognition): Real-time hand gesture recognition for controlling a PC via webcam, using hand landmark detection.
- [Personal Health Tracker](https://mharsh.me/projects/personal-health-tracker): Offline-capable PWA for tracking workouts, body metrics, and progress photos, with Groq AI insights and Google Drive backup.
- [Airline Review Analyzer](https://mharsh.me/projects/airline-review-analyzer): Web app analyzing airline passenger reviews for sentiment trends across carriers.
- [Vakil Legal Bot](https://mharsh.me/projects/vakil-legal-bot): Hackathon-built legal assistant translating complex legal jargon into plain English.

## Experience

- Roboparadigm (2025–Present): Agentic robotics pipeline for lab automation — modular perception-planning-execution stack with RealSense/YOLO perception, LangGraph task planning, Redis event bus, and ROS 2/MoveIt 2 execution.
